The Batman Part 2 is an upcoming American superhero film directed by Matt Reeves from a screenplay he wrote with Mattson Tomlin. Based on the DC Comics character Batman, it is the sequel to The Batman (2022). Robert Pattinson stars as Bruce Wayne / Batman alongside Jeffrey Wright, Andy Serkis, Colin Farrell, Scarlett Johansson, Sebastian Stan, and Charles Dance. Set during the winter, Batman investigates further corruption after the flooding of Gotham City. Warner Bros. Pictures will distribute the film, which Reeves also produces with Lynn Harris and Dylan Clark, alongside James Gunn and Peter Safran of DC Studios.


The Batman Part II is scheduled to be theatrically released in the United States on February 18, 2028, following several delays. A third film is planned to conclude the trilogy.
